court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
trial_court: Court of Magistrate at Solapur and Ld. Civil Judge Senior Division, Ratnagiri
case_name: Samruddhi Amit Berde vs Mr. Amit Vasant Berde
acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: After marriage, parties had a child with the applicant as custodian. Husband initiated divorce proceedings under Hindu Marriage Act while wife initiated proceedings under Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the applicant to establish hardship.
legal_principles.held: Considering the distance between Ratnagiri and Solapur and applicant is custodian of minor child, if she is made to travel, she is likely to suffer more hardship.

legal_principles.principle: Convenience should be considered when transferring proceedings.
legal_principles.held: Rather it will be convenient to non-Applicant to attend the proceedings.

outcome.final_order: Application is allowed in terms of prayer clause (b) which reads thus: ...
